ruled_out_vectors.vector: C1: Pool type returns inflated amountOut or fees — Core->PoolType boundary
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: _validateProtocolFees (AMMModule:1662) reverts if totalFees > amountIn. _safeDecrementUint128 (AMMModule:1437) reverts if amountOut > reserve. actualAmountIn check (AMMModule:1405) prevents pool type from claiming more than provided.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C2: Handler delivers wrong token amount — Core->Handler boundary
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Strict balance-delta check at AMMModule:2207-2209: balanceInBefore + amountIn != balanceInAfter causes revert. Handler cannot short-change or over-deliver without detection.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C3: Hook returns manipulated fee exceeding swap amount — Core->Hook boundary
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Hook fees are BPS-based (max 10000 = 100%). At AMMModule:2616, if feeAmount > swapAmountIn, revert LBAMM__InsufficientInputForFees. User protected by limitAmount check.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C4: Registry settings change between beforeSwap and afterSwap — Hook->Registry boundary
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: registryUpdateTokenSettings (AMMStandardHook:519) has no reentrancy guard or swap-in-progress lock. Registry can push new settings mid-swap. However, registry is a trusted admin contract — only protocol governance can trigger. Each hook call reads independently from storage; inconsistency only causes different fee BPS between before/after (bounded by swap amount). Governance trust assumption, not exploitable by external users.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C5: Pool type feeAmount > amountIn — PoolType->Core return validation
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: _validateProtocolFees at AMMModule:1662 checks totalFees > amountIn and reverts. Pool type cannot extract more fees than the swap input.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C6: Reentrancy via handler callback or token transfer (ERC-777/1155) — Handler->External boundary
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Handler callback (_executeTransferHandlerCallback at AMMModule:2250-2252) executes AFTER balance-delta check, all fee transfers, and output transfer. ENTERED reentrancy bit is preserved by TstorishReentrancyGuardWithFlags._setReentrancyFlags, blocking re-entry into any swap function.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C7: Hook callback access control — direct external calls to beforeSwap/afterSwap
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMStandardHook._requireCallerIsAMM (L940-944) enforced on all state-modifying hooks: beforeSwap (L110), afterSwap (L159), validateAddLiquidity (L253), validatePoolCreation (L312). validateHandlerOrder is view-only (no access control by design).

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C8: Settlement conservation — handler must deliver exact amountIn
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMModule:2180 snapshots balanceOf(tokenIn) before handler call. AMMModule:2208 requires exact match: balanceBefore + amountIn == balanceAfter. Fee-on-transfer tokens fail by design.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C9: Hook fee integrity — total deducted fees exceed swap amount
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: In _applySwapByInputInputFees: each hook fee is checked independently (L2616, L2629). If any fee exceeds remaining swapAmountIn, revert LBAMM__InsufficientInputForFees. Sequential deduction ensures total cannot exceed original amount.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C10: Output exceeds reserves — pool type claims amountOut > reserve
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: _safeDecrementUint128 at AMMModule:1437/1440 reverts on underflow. Solidity 0.8+ checked arithmetic provides secondary defense.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C11: Denomination consistency — token ordering mismatch in pools
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: _createPool at AMMModule:117-119 enforces token0 < token1, swapping both tokens AND hook data. Pool ID encodes ordered tokens. All subsequent reserve operations reference the same PoolState ordering.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C12: Sandwich resistance — pricing bounds bypass
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: AMMStandardHook._validatePricingBounds (L823-871) checks sqrtPriceX96 against configured bounds. One-directional check: allows recovery swaps but blocks further manipulation. Direct swaps (poolType=0) always revert if outside bounds. Pricing bounds are per-token-pair configurable by registry.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C13: Pool ID encoding — field extraction errors with max values
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: PoolDecoder.getPoolFee extracts uint16 at POOL_ID_FEE_SHIFT=0. PoolDecoder.getPoolType extracts address at POOL_ID_TYPE_ADDRESS_SHIFT=144. Fields do not overlap. Max fee 0xFFFF correctly extracted. Pool type address leading zeros enforced by POOL_TYPE_ADDRESS_MASK.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C14: createPool edge parameters — invalid fee, zero pool hook with dynamic fee
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: _createPool validates: fee > MAX_BPS must equal DYNAMIC_POOL_FEE_BPS (AMMModule:100-106), dynamic fee requires non-zero poolHook (L103-105), pool type address must have 6 leading zero bytes (L109-111), same-token pairing rejected (L113-115), pool ID verified against details (L124-129), duplicate pool rejected (L131-133).

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C15: Diamond storage collision — facets overwriting shared state
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Slither storage layout analysis confirms all 4 diamond facets (AMMModule, ModuleAdmin, ModuleFeeCollection, ModuleLiquidity) have 0 direct storage slots. All state is in shared AppStorage at slot 0x9A1D.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C16: Halmos symbolic verification of pricing bounds and hook fees
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Halmos check_C16_pricingBoundsDirection PASSED (10 paths verified). check_C16_hookFeeBounded TIMEOUT (non-linear arithmetic in mulDiv exceeds Z3 solver capability). Forge fuzz tests cover hook fee bounds via assertion tests.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C17: Medusa assertion fuzzing on AMMStandardHook
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Medusa ran 56,994 calls across 19 assertion tests on AMMStandardHook. 288 branches covered. 0 assertion violations found. All external functions tested including beforeSwap, afterSwap, validateAddLiquidity, registryUpdateTokenSettings.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C18: Medusa assertion fuzzing on SingleProviderPoolType
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Medusa ran 103,121 calls across 11 assertion tests on SingleProviderPoolType. 177 branches covered. 0 assertion violations found. All pool type functions tested including swapByInput, swapByOutput, addLiquidity, removeLiquidity.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C19: Hook/pool accounting desync (Bunni pattern) — beforeSwap state persists while afterSwap reverts
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: In _poolSwapByInput, beforeSwap, pool swap, and afterSwap are in the same internal call chain with no try/catch. If afterSwap reverts, entire tx reverts including beforeSwap. Bunni pattern impossible.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C20: Diamond function selector collision across facets
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Verified no 4-byte selector collisions among key functions: singleSwap, addLiquidity, removeLiquidity, setFlashLoanBPS, executeQueuedHookFeesByHookTransfers. Diamond proxy dispatches by selector match.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C21: Transient storage cross-path contamination (ChainSecurity pattern)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT (0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF) is only used by beforeSwap/afterSwap in AMMStandardHook. addLiquidity/removeLiquidity do not read transient storage. Known HOOK-001 issue (stale value in same-tx multi-op) accepted as Low severity.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: C22: Hook return value manipulation (Uniswap V4 hook fee vectors)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Hook fee returned as absolute amount (not BPS) at AMMModule:2522. Core validates: fee > remaining swapAmount reverts (L2616, L2629). User protected by limitAmount. Token creator controls which hook is used (not an external attack vector).
